question:
A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K, then how is K related to W?
solution:

Given:

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

Given: ‘W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K'

1) W # Q

means 'W is father of Q.

2) Q @ T

means 'Q is son of T.

3) T & Y

means 'T is sister of Y.

4) Y @ M

means 'Y is son of M.

**5) M % K**

means 'M is wife of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c75b253cb831efbe8d3d97d35f6ddad3aa75d3c0255d7e01fad8bec6a26ab216.png] 

Hence, K is the 'father-in-law' of W.
